_readme: Source registry. Each source becomes one codon via `node scripts/build-hank.mjs`. fetch: 'ics' = calendar feed parsed by script; 'page' = listing page(s) fetched as markdown by page.mjs (curl, then a headless local browser; free) for the agent to extract. Review proposed-sources.md after each run and add approved sources here.

sources.name: Eventbrite Boston
sources.notes: Skip online events, webinars and recurring promos.

sources.name: Boston Central
sources.notes: The listing is a single-day calendar: the date in its heading applies to every event on it, so use that date rather than opening detail pages to find one.

sources.name: Luma Boston
sources.notes: Feed of luma.com/boston. Many events are tech/startup meetups; set city from LOCATION, and skip online-only events and events whose location is hidden until registration unless the city is clear.

sources.name: Malden Events
sources.notes: Community calendar for Malden. Each event has a VIEW link to its detail page; use that as the url. Keep public in-person events (markets, outdoor, arts, family, food); skip high-school sports, business networking and recurring classes.

sources.name: Fever Boston
sources.notes: Ticketed experiences (Candlelight concerts, tours, comedy, dining). Most listings show a date range such as "27 Sep - 22 Nov":  if it overlaps the window, record one event with date = the later of its first date and the window start, and endDate = its last date. Skip items with no dates, items that start after the window, and venues outside Boston, Cambridge and Brookline (e.g. Plymouth). Use the feverup.com/m/<id> link as url, and take the venue from the text before the title (e.g. Simons Theatre, First Church in Cambridge). Price is the "From $" amount.

sources.name: Open Newbury Street
sources.notes: Seasonal car-free Newbury Street program page; list only dated events or programming (street closures days, performances, markets) and skip general program description.

sources.name: City of Cambridge calendar
sources.notes: ICS feed behind the city calendar (city departments and the public library branches). Keep public events of general interest; skip meetings, hearings and recurring classes.

sources.name: City of Somerville events
sources.notes: Skip board/commission meetings and hearings.

sources.name: Public Library of Brookline
sources.notes: LibCal feed behind the library's events page. Keep public programs; skip ongoing classes and anything marked full or cancelled.

sources.name: City of Medford events calendar
sources.notes: Skip board/commission meetings, hearings and recurring classes.

sources.name: MIT Events
sources.notes: Very high volume. Keep only events open to the public and of general interest; drop seminars for specialists, office hours, deadlines, club meetings and internal events.

sources.name: Northeastern University Calendar
sources.notes: Keep only events open to the public and of general interest.

sources.name: Harvard Gazette events
sources.notes: Trumba feed behind the Harvard Gazette events page. An exhibition or other run listed on many days: record it once, on its first date in the window, with endDate set to its last date in the feed.

sources.name: BU Spark! events
sources.notes: Small listing of Spark! (BU Faculty of Computing & Data Sciences) events: Code & Tell nights, demo days, hackathons. Link each event to its ticket or detail page.

sources.name: Tufts events
sources.notes: Trumba feed behind events.tufts.edu. Keep only events open to the public and of general interest; drop internal student, staff and course events.

sources.name: Museum of Fine Arts
sources.notes: From /exhibitions: record each exhibition that shows "Through <date>" once, with date set to the first day of the window, endDate set to the closing date, and url set to the exhibition's page; skip the permanent "Ongoing" galleries. From /programs: keep public programs (talks, films, concerts, tours, family days, open studios); skip multi-week studio art courses and classes. /events only sells admission tickets, so it is not used.

sources.name: Boston Symphony Orchestra
sources.notes: Tanglewood events are in western MA; skip them.

sources.name: Assembly Row
sources.notes: Events Calendar feed for Assembly Row (Orange Line): markets, live music on The Lawn, yoga and seasonal events.

sources.name: CACHE in Medford
sources.notes: Medford arts and culture: concerts, workshops, community days. Keep public events only. The feed returns 30 events per request, so the extra URLs start 5 and 10 days into the window; events can appear in more than one, so keep one record each.

sources.name: Patch Malden Calendar
sources.notes: Community calendar that also covers nearby towns. Set city from the venue or address text; keep only Malden and Medford events and skip Stoneham, Winchester, Melrose and other towns. Skip sign-up and registration promos (for example youth hockey signups) and school open houses.

sources.name: Brookline.News Events
sources.notes: Community events calendar. Each entry shows a date, time, category tags and a sponsor's link; use the sponsor's link as url. Many events appear twice, so keep one. Skip library events already covered by brookline-library, and skip online events. Map tags to categories: Food & Wine to food & drink, Families & Children to family, Recreation & Outdoors to sports & outdoors, Music & Dance to music.

sources.name: Somerville Arts Council
sources.notes: Arts, music and community events with venue names; all Somerville unless the venue is elsewhere. Use the category links (Music and so on) to pick the category. Skip grant deadlines, workshops for artists only and past events.

sources.name: Cambridge Office for Tourism
sources.notes: Tourism events feed (Harvard Sq, Central Sq, Kendall and so on). Long-running exhibitions: one record on the first in-window date with the full run in the description. Skip events already in the harvard or mit feeds if duplicated.

sources.name: Boston Public Market
sources.notes: Month-grid calendar. Keep tastings, classes, trivia, kids' hours, yoga and live music dated in the window. Multi-day Oktoberfest items marked All-day: one record on the first in-window date. Face painting and kids' activity hours: category family.
